data.reportText: Netflix, Inc. Common Stock is expected* to report earnings on  10/20/2026 after market close.  The report will be for the fiscal Quarter ending Sep 2026.  According to Zacks Investment Research, based on  11 analysts'  forecasts, the consensus EPS forecast for the quarter is $0.82.  The reported EPS for the same quarter last year was $0.59.
